name: Serbia

fees.name: Short-stay visa (Visa C)
fees.applies: nationalities requiring a visa (fee example published by Serbian Embassy in India; paid in local currency equivalent at country of application)
fees.notes: Consular fee stated by Embassy of Serbia in New Delhi as 92 EUR / 9,240 INR. Children under 12: 47 EUR / 4,722 INR. Fee is paid in local currency at the mission where applied; amount may vary slightly by country/exchange rate. General MFA visa-requirements page confirms a visa fee applies but does not itself publish the amount.

fees.name: Long-stay visa (Visa D)
fees.applies: nationalities requiring a visa, long-stay/multiple entry purposes
fees.notes: Consular fee stated by Embassy of Serbia in New Delhi as 52 EUR / 5,222 INR. Not a tourist-specific product but the general long-stay visa category; included for completeness.

fees.name: eVisa (Visa C, submitted via Welcome to Serbia portal)
fees.applies: nationals of select countries eligible for the electronic visa C application track
fees.notes: The e-visa portal (evisa.welcometoserbia.gov.rs) lets eligible applicants submit a Visa C or Visa D application online instead of visiting a mission in person, but the portal itself does not publish a distinct fee schedule -- the same consular visa-C/visa-D fees apply. Could not verify a separate published e-visa amount, so left null rather than guessing.

reciprocity_variations.note: 92 EUR (~9,240 INR) for Visa C up to 90 days; 47 EUR (~4,722 INR) for children under 12. Source: Embassy of Serbia in New Delhi.

free_visa_notes: Serbia maintains an extensive visa-free regime: nationals of most EU/Schengen countries, the US, UK, Canada, and many other countries can enter visa-free for short tourist stays (typically up to 90 days). Nationals of China, Armenia, Mali and Syria are exempt from paying the visa fee even when a visa is required, per bilateral agreements (per general search of MFA-linked sources; verify per-nationality exemption on the country-specific 'Visa regime for entering Serbia' pages at mfa.gov.rs before publishing per-country claims). Serbia does not use VFS Global or another outsourced centre for its own outbound visa issuance -- applications are handled directly by Serbian diplomatic-consular missions or via the Welcome to Serbia e-visa/e-services portal; VFS Global centres in Belgrade found in search results serve applications INTO other countries (e.g., Canada, UK), not into Serbia.
